args.title: Document byte order mark usage in CSV exports
args.body:
File: src/export/csv.ts

Add documentation explaining that the byte order mark (BOM) prefix in CSV exports is on by default to help spreadsheet apps detect UTF-8 encoding. Clarify that this behavior is deliberate and can be turned off via options.

label: feature
file: src/export/csv.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The presence of the byte order mark (BOM) in CSV exports is deliberate and controlled by a "bom" option in src/export/csv.ts. It is on by default to help spreadsheet applications detect UTF-8 encoding when opening CSV files directly. This should be documented as the current behavior.
